title: release-kit .release.json, schema version 1
description: A repo's release-kit settings. apply writes it and keeps the choices; every key is optional. Keys the kit doesn't know are allowed, so a newer kit's file still validates against an older schema.

versionFiles.description: Other files that carry the version: a path, or { path, pattern } with one capture group for the version.

workflows.description: How the workflows reach the kit.

train.description: The release train: when it runs (UTC cron) and the workflows it runs on its release commit.

repository.description: owner/repo: the one repo whose Release and train jobs run.

branches.description: The branches releases are cut from (default main, master).

stable.description: true: a 0.y.z repo may reach 1.0.0, and breaking changes bump major.

node.description: The Node version for the workflows.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone for changelog dates.

style.description: "classic" keeps commit-type headings and scopes; anything else reads New, Fixed, Faster, Safer.

releases.description: true (default) writes releases.json; false turns it off; { feed: true } adds releases.xml.

dependabot.description: Major updates the dependabot.yml apply writes ignores (docs/UPGRADES.md). The kit ignores typescript majors by default; a value the kit can't use keeps that default.

ignoreMajors.description: More packages whose major updates Dependabot doesn't propose (minor and patch updates still arrive), added to the kit's list: exact package names.

allowMajors.description: Entries of the kit's list (today: typescript) whose major updates this repo does take.

autoMerge.description: false: apply writes no auto-merge.yml. An object tightens the auto-merge policy (docs/AUTO_MERGE.md); a value the kit can't use keeps its safe default.

minorWaitDays.description: Days a Dependabot minor update (and any Dependabot update of release-kit) waits after its pull request opens before it may merge on its own. 0 turns the wait off.

patchWaitDays.description: The same for a patch update.

hold.description: More packages that always wait for a person, added to the kit's list: exact names, or a prefix ending in * like "@acme/*".

unhold.description: Entries of the kit's hold list this repo doesn't hold, written as they are there.
